negativeControlScope: 15 representative guard regressions through direct Gherkin, in isolated disposable real-source copies. Each must fail on an AssertionError in a named scenario/step, not an import error or timeout. These demonstrate sensitivity to the listed mutations and do not claim one mutation for every old assertion or every possible defect.

migrationCorrections.incorrectMigration: Comparing entire HTTP response bodies after repeating the exact HTTP receipt ID expected no duplicate metadata.
migrationCorrections.originalPremise: Original pure LocalModel request calls use distinct event IDs and compare the saved domain Reply; an identical HTTP receipt legitimately adds duplicate:true.
migrationCorrections.correction: Keep the original complete pure Reply equality and intent-count assertion. HTTP repeats and a different click must retain code/detail/taskId and exactly one physical operation; receipt-level duplicate metadata is checked in its own boundary, not removed from the domain assertion.

migrationCorrections.incorrectMigration: A single waiting operation whose approval and parent work share the same deadline was expected to return HOST_APPROVAL_EXPIRED.
migrationCorrections.originalPremise: The original exact HOST_APPROVAL_EXPIRED test creates two requests at distinct controlled times; the first request expires before its later parent work. The single waiting-operation test asserted refusal only.
migrationCorrections.correction: Preserve the distinct timestamps 1 and 20 and exact HOST_APPROVAL_EXPIRED in the unexpired-successor row. The equal-deadline row respects existing parent-first WORK_EXPIRED and still requires expiry, refusal and no start. No deadline was widened and no expected refusal was weakened.

migrationCorrections.incorrectMigration: Reading localAwaitingApproval from the original cached m.work predating snapshot round trips.
migrationCorrections.originalPremise: The original assertion reads the current persisted context intent.
migrationCorrections.correction: Observe m.c.intents[0] exactly as the original did; negative claim/start replies are produced in When and the waiting status/checkpoint/quota are asserted in Then.

migrationCorrections.incorrectMigration: Requiring final context.reply.code to stay non-OK after a successful LOCAL_APPROVAL_EXPIRED settlement.
migrationCorrections.originalPremise: The denied approval precedes a successful expiry settlement; final Reply is legitimately OK while approval/result record the expiry.
migrationCorrections.correction: Keep the exact initial denial assertion and check final persisted expired approval and HOST_APPROVAL_EXPIRED receipt, with no startedAt or physical command.

environmentFailures.cause: A concurrent map-capacity step import was temporarily stale; final fresh model-gate-restored run passed after its owner aligned the export.

Managed sandbox denied spawnSync process-control invocation with EPERM after adding timeout/killSignal; command was rerun with the authorized process permissions. The gate rejects run.error and null status.

limits: Pure model gate selects only host labels whose product operations use real taskMachine/persisted-snapshot round trips and controlled inputs; importing integration step definitions constructs no integration fixtures. Its outer runner reads source hashes/writes reports. HTTP/SQLite/process acceptance stays in the appropriate direct scenarios and existing integration tests; no product, business model, formal skill, dependency or acceptance-gap change.
